subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

I know how hardest you have tried to fit in my shoes.
solution:
The erroneous part is: **I know how hardest**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the superlative adjective "**hardest**".
 
• The word "**how**" should be followed by a **positive adjective**, not a **superlative adjective**.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**how hard**", ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **option 3** of the sentence.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I know how hard you have tried to fit in my shoes."*
